newsitem.title: USA: Apogee Enterprises sets 100 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Apogee Enterprises sets 100 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Apogee Enterprises Inc said on Monday that its directors approved a stock split in the form of a 100 percent common stock dividend payable February 14, 1997, to holders on record of on January 28, 1997.
After the dividend, there will be about 27,425,000 shares of Apogee common stock outstanding.
Apogee also said its board approved payment of a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.09 a share on February 12, 1997 to shareholders of record on January 28, 1997.
The cash dividend is being paid on a pre-split basis. Following the stock split, the new dividend rate would be $0.045 a share.
Apogee makes, distributes and installs of glass products and systems.
